        ],
        "scope_text": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.",

        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F002",
          "F003",
          "F004"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F002:F004",
        "choice_text": "Any of the following situations: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.",
        "logic_quote": "F003",
        "references": [
          "1544.201",
          "1546.201",
          "1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about the individual's person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23."

    },

        ],
        "scope_text": "Applies to the carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is one of the qualifying individuals specified in paragraph (b).",

        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [

          "F007",
          "F008"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F005:F008",
        "choice_text": "The individual must be one of the following: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.",

          "1546.211",

      }
    },
    {

        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F009"
        ],
        "scope_text": "A passenger transporting or offering for transport baggage in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.",

        "scope_text": "A passenger transporting or offering for transport baggage in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23, unless all conditions of paragraphs (c)(2)(i) through (iv) are met.",

unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Any of the following situations: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about the individual's person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to the carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is one of the qualifying individuals specified in paragraph (b).
unit_attributes.choice_text: The individual must be one of the following: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply to the carriage of firearms and other weapons on or about an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport, an individual authorized to carry a weapon under 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562, or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.scope_text: A passenger transporting or offering for transport baggage in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any loaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.

unit_attributes.scope_text: A passenger transporting or offering for transport baggage in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23, unless all conditions of paragraphs (c)(2)(i) through (iv) are met.
unit_attributes.choice_text: All of the following conditions are required to be satisfied: (i) the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; (ii) the firearm is unloaded; (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) the container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unloaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23 unless the passenger declares it orally or in writing to the aircraft operator before checking that the firearm is in the bag and unloaded, the firearm is unloaded, the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container, and the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination.

unit_attributes.scope_text: A passenger transporting or offering for transport baggage in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unauthorized explosive or incendiary in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm under 49 CFR 1540.111.
unit_attributes.choice_text: In checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.statement: 49 CFR 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing the carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
